Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed classroom and facility data with permanent and portable counts, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans (pp. 43-49). Robust condition assessment with prioritized projects addressing immediate and long-term needs, integrating facility condition with educational priorities (pp. 50-54).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology explained, including cohort survival rates, demographic data, and residential development impact (pp. 26-42). Capacity utilization data by site and classroom with state and district loading standards, linked to enrollment projections and facility actions (pp. 43-51).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle with detailed descriptions of classroom types, specialized spaces (science labs, CTE, arts, special education), and alignment with district mission and instructional goals (pp. 13-25). Facility projects and strategies are directly connected to educational needs and program requirements.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Some references to outdoor spaces such as athletic fields, playgrounds, and site modernization including fencing and landscaping (pp. 50-54). However, lacks districtwide data on green space, canopy cover, or detailed greening strategies; outdoor learning and climate resilience connections are minimal or absent.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges health and safety improvements and some infrastructure upgrades (e.g., HVAC, fire alarms) but does not provide a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies across the district (pp. 50-54). Climate readiness is not a central theme.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as HVAC replacement, LED lighting, solar parking lot shade structures, and energy-efficient irrigation (pp. 50-54). References to energy resilience and electrification are present but not comprehensive; no detailed energy use data or full integration with state mandates.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive financial plan with detailed funding sources including state School Facility Program eligibility, Proposition 39 funds, local bonds, and other financing mechanisms (pp. 56-65). Prioritization framework for projects and alignment with district educational priorities demonstrated; includes cost estimates and funding balances.
